A vast, ruined Gothic castle rises beneath a turbulent gray-black sky, viewed from deep within a devastated courtyard. Towering stone structures surround the scene on three sides, their ornate facades fractured, leaning, and partially collapsed. In the center background, several narrow spires climb toward a bright opening in the storm clouds, silhouetted against cold silvery light. Broken walls and exposed architectural ribs frame the castle like the remains of an enormous stone skeleton. Tattered black banners hang across a shadowed entrance beneath the central structure, flanked by large heraldic emblems bearing skeletal eagle-like designs. At the top of a broad stone staircase sits an elaborate pale throne, conspicuously empty and illuminated against the darkness around it. The foreground is filled with rubble, shattered masonry, twisted metal, fallen ornamental crowns, ash, and scattered debris. Small orange flames burn at the lower left while thin smoke and mist drift through the ruins. The composition draws the eye upward from the wreckage, along the staircase, to the solitary throne and finally the immense decaying castle beyond.
